Auditor finds a missing March accrual, April already underway:

1. Reopen March (status -> Open)
2. Post the correcting journal
3. Re-run trial balance / translation / consolidation
4. Re-close March
5. Notify everyone who used the old numbers
caption: Five extra steps — for one journal that could have been caught before close.
